audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 1, 5 and 6 disagreed across layers: phases[].side read Skill/Skill/.../Skill/Skill while content win[] and the packet chart read Brand/Brand/.../Lissandra/Lissandra.
audit.why: Sear is a 1050-range line and Pillar of Flame is 900, both beyond Lissandra's 725 Q and far beyond her 450 W, so levels 1-2 are his. From the first item her point-and-click R and E-W-R chain beat an immobile mage with no dash and no shield.
audit.corrected: Four sides realigned to the content/packet chart as one atomic group; the two whys whose verdict flipped were rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.why: Level 6 and first-item spikes are correctly placed with Lissandra; Brand's own spike is early poke, already reflected once rows 0-1 are moved to him.
audit.corrected: Spike text reworded only where it named a mechanic Brand does not have.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and whys[4] both said Lissandra's R interrupts Brand's 'channel'. Pyroclasm is not a channel — Riot's text describes a torrent that bounces up to 5 times.
audit.why: Telling a player to R for an interrupt that does not exist teaches the wrong reflex. The real interaction is that Sear only stuns while Blaze is on you, so the stun is conditional on his own burn.
audit.corrected: R described as unmissable point-and-click lockdown that stops him mid-Pyroclasm rather than interrupting a channel; the Blaze-gates-Sear condition stated with the 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Sear 8s to 6s, Conflagration 13s, Frozen Tomb 120s now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles; dosFull[2].d did not match its own title either.
audit.why: lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED; a reader sees the title promise one thing and the body answer another.
audit.corrected: Three bullet bodies rewritten to their own titles using Blaze's 3-stack, 2-second detonation and Sear's cooldown.

edits.before: Q-shatter the wave and chip his melee step-ups — your early Q harass is better than the lane gives it credit for.
edits.after: Sear reaches 1050 and Pillar of Flame 900 — both out-range your 725 Q, so eat the chip and farm at your own range.

edits.before: W online: anyone who closes onto you eats a root. The anti-engage layer is already real at level 2.
edits.after: W roots at 450, but he never has to come that close — level 2 is still his poke, not your trade.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Frozen Tomb (self-cast) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sear is 8s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5, and only stuns while Blaze is on you — clear of the burn, that 1050-range line is just damage. - Conflagration is 13s. - Guard the 120s Frozen Tomb like a fifth summoner spell and spend it only on kill windows, never on his poke.

edits.before: Q-shatter his wave contact, and when he steps to punish, W-root into full rotation and walk — the root tax makes every aggressive step expensive.
edits.after: When his third Blaze stack lands the detonation is 2 seconds out — that is your self-R timer, not a panic button; take the burst inside dark ice.

edits.before: Brand whiffs Sear (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Sear down for 6-8s means his stun is gone — Q shatter freely.

edits.before: Clawing in with W on cooldown 'to poke' — an engage tool spent on chip damage is a Lissandra standing in melee range with no ice left.
edits.after: A 120s ultimate spent on a Brand with Sear and Conflagration down buys nothing — he was already harmless for those seconds.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze with Pillar, stunning the burn with Sear, and bursting you before your root lands.

edits.before: Ahead, hunt: claw into every river skirmish first, tomb the carry, and snowball picks — Brand farming under tower can't stop a roaming Lissandra.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the stack: claw in the moment Sear is spent, root and tomb him before Blaze reaches three, and take the wave he cannot contest.

edits.before: Carry through picks — claw-root-tomb converts vision into kills better than any control mage; the map shrinks every time your E is up.
edits.after: Carry by punishing an immobile mage — Brand has no dash and no shield, so a landed 450-range root is the whole fight for him.

edits.before: Your R point-and-click hard-CC shuts down his channel damage instantly, so you win every all-in when Pillar of Flame combos are on cooldown.
edits.after: Your R is point-and-click, so nothing he does dodges it — stun him out of Pyroclasm's bounces and win the all-in whenever Sear is on its 8s.

edits.before: At 6 your point-and-click R hard-locks his channel and wins the all-in for you.
edits.after: At 6 your point-and-click R stuns him out of Pyroclasm and wins the all-in for you.

notes: packet.suspectNames flags wants.you[1] 'Bait Pillar of Flame' as a probable wrong name — it is a FALSE POSITIVE. Pillar of Flame is Brand's real W per the kit; the field is left untouched. Content win[0..6] already matched packet.levelChart, so only the stale full-layer sides moved and no win[N] twin edits were possible (before would equal after). Ratings left alone. Not asserted: whether Lissandra's self-R invulnerability prevents the Blaze detonation from applying, and whether Pyroclasm can be QSS'd or cleansed off — neither is in Riot's text.
